validity.researcher_notes: This row exists, is correctly classified (interstate gas transmission expansion), and is not a duplicate of any other roster PID -- it is Transco's own, singularly named Southeast Supply Enhancement Project (FERC Docket CP25-10-000), distinct from P7800 'Power Express Project' (a separate, intrastate-Virginia-only Transco expansion with different capacity) and from the unrelated, decade-earlier 'Southeast Supply Header Pipeline' (CP07-44, completed 2008) that shares similar wording in EIA's project-name field but is a different, already-completed project -- confirmed NOT to be conflated here. All five spec-level discrepancies below trace to the same root cause: the sheet's values were set from the project's Oct 2024 filing-announcement vintage (a rounded '30 mi + 24 mi' and a rounded 1500 MMcf/d, plus a fall-2026 CONSTRUCTION target that was itself correctly reported by the sheet's own cited source but recorded on the sheet as 2025-09), while the certificated FERC/EIA/press vintage (Jan-Feb 2026 forward) states more precise and, for construction timing, materially later figures. None of these discrepancies raise existence, classification, or attribution doubt -- Owner/Operator/Fuel/PipelineType/Location/Diameter all confirm cleanly. Detail and citations for each field are in the corresponding fills[] entries (Capacity, Length, Construction, Start).
